The inaugural 2017 season of [[Dana White's Contender Series]] included a total of 8 weekly shows. Viewers had a choice of a traditional commentary team, or alternate commentary provided by rapper [[Snoop Dogg]] and UFC Hall of Famer [[Urijah Faber]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.espn.com/mma/story/_/id/19777361/snoop-dogg-urijah-faber-serve-alternate-commentary-team-dana-white-tuesday-night-contender-series|title=Snoop Dogg serving play-by-play on UFC show}}</ref> Commentators included active fighter [[Paul Felder]] who would go on to commentate on UFC events.
